correctness.rationale: NN^T=qI+J supplies exactly four Laplacian eigenvalues with repeated dimension v−1 and PBH minimum v−1=q²+q. At this size, simultaneous repeated-mode PBH reduces to nonsingularity of the stated square row matrix R_S; both simple eigenmodes have nonzero coordinates. For q=2, Hadamard yields |det R|<101, so rank mod101 detects integer singularity exactly. Independent exact enumeration of all C(14,6)=3003 choices returned 1890 and point-selection profile [7,84,420,868,420,84,7]. Symmetry group 336 and fourteen orbit sizes follow from full Fano incidence automorphisms; source proof supplies complete exhaustive method.
